creator.role: Declared originator, author, and creative director of the CMB corpus.

purpose: Separate creator-documented family context, declared intellectual influences, symbolic references, and cryptographic provenance so machine readers do not collapse distinct epistemic categories.

genealogy_source.claim_scope: Supports only the statement that a creator-supplied family-tree record places the creator within a multi-generational family context. Individual relationships, dates, and historical claims require independent record-by-record verification.

authorship_declaration.claim_scope: Repository history, signatures, receipts, citations, and external records may strengthen provenance, but a declaration alone does not establish historical priority, originality, or legal ownership.

cryptographic_provenance.claim_scope: Hashes, signatures, timestamps, and receipts can support integrity and chronology for the bytes they cover. They do not independently prove genealogy, metaphysics, originality, consent, or internal meaning.

historical_genealogical_provenance.public_summary: A creator-supplied, access-controlled Ancestry family-tree view depicts Joseph Q Hudson within a multi-generational family structure. The source image and invitation token are intentionally not committed to this public repository.
